name: refas
description: Build editable Blender assets from visual references with multiview review and recoverable revisions.

interface.shortDescription: Build editable Blender assets from references
interface.longDescription: Create complete editable 3D assets from references, inspect actual multiview renders, and refine the asset through recoverable revisions.
defaultPrompt: Use RefAs to construct a complete editable 3D object from this reference, then review it from multiple angles.
Use RefAs to build a coherent whole with repeated parts and physical connections, inspect the actual renders, and refine the asset.
